description: LUYFIV crystallizes in the monoclinic crystal system with space group P 21/n. Reported CIF formula moiety: C94 H114 N3 O14 S10 Sm3,2(C2 H3 N1),C5 H5 N1,3(H2 O1). From the CIF bond table, Sm2 (Sm) has 7 O neighbors; Sm2B (Sm) has 7 O neighbors; Sm1? (Sm) has 0 O neighbors. Oxygen-bridged metal-site graph: 1 pairs, 2 components; largest component is a chain with insufficient metal sites for a 3D shape classification. Computed bridged metal-metal separations span 5.261-5.261 Å (not direct metal-metal bonds). Computed M-O-M angles span 180.00-180.00°; individual values and O labels are in metal_framework.links. Article card reports molecular formula C94H114N3O14S10Sm3·2(MeCN)·py·3(H2O). Explicit grouped units in the article formula/name: 1 H2O (explicit grouped unit in article formula).
interpretation_limit: Oxidation states, nuclearity, oxo/hydroxo bridging, core charge and ligand identities/counts require article/SI or manual verification; atom-site counts are asymmetric-unit counts, not molecular stoichiometry. Graph topology is limited to identity-symmetry bonds in the CIF table. Approximate shape is based only on bridge-unwrapped metal-site coordinates in the largest component; symmetry-related bonds or periodic structures require manual crystallographic review. Empirical formulas alone do not establish unique oxidation-state assignments or ligand connectivity; annotations above reproduce explicit structural notation only.
